build_xml_rtl_descriptor: run build_xml.py with input template and rtl_root to generate XML RTL descriptor for OpenCL compilation
include_sv_files: call include_sv_files with a list of SystemVerilog filenames to register them for RTL output concatenation
include_stub_files: call include_stub_files with a list of OpenCL stub filenames to register them for stub output concatenation
set_type_width: call set_type_width with an integer width value to set the TYPE_WIDTH template variable in the XML output
set_acc_divide_cycles: call set_acc_divide_cycles with an integer cycle count to set the ACC_DIVIDE_CYCLES template variable in the XML output
